title: A morphism of triangles whose first two components are homotopy equivalences has the third one too
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-third-isomorphism at source lines 1015-1028: for a dg algebra A and a morphism (a, b, c) of the triangles built from two maps f_1 and f_2 of dg A-modules, if a and b are homotopy equivalences then so is c. The proof at source lines 1030-1062 has to manufacture the inverse of c and then verify it. It picks homotopy inverses a^{-1} and b^{-1} for a and b in the homotopy category, uses the author's functoriality of the cone to build a map c' : C(f_2) -> C(f_1) out of them, and then must show that c' is an inverse of c up to homotopy. The verification is where the work is: the composites c' c and c c' are shown to have square zero in the homotopy category by exhibiting the commutativity-up-to-homotopy of a three-term diagram whose rows are admissible short exact sequences and invoking the author's nilpotence result, after which the explicit inverse 2 - c is read off. The statement records only the conclusion. The two invoked author results are retained alongside so their references resolve inside the package.
